phases_and_microstructures.name: gamma-prime phase
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: It is evident that this is caused by dissolution of the y'-phase, by the absence of hardening elements of the solid solution such as molybdenum, tungsten, and chrome

phases_and_microstructures.name: Ni-Ti oxide
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 1 h

attributes.composition: mainly oxides of nickel and titanium with inclusions of Al, Co, Cr oxides

evidence.quote: the formation of a multilayer scale whose external layer (10-15/~m thick) consists mainly of oxides of nickel and titanium with inclusions of oxides of aluminum, cobalt, and chrome

phases_and_microstructures.name: alumina layer
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 1 h

evidence.quote: At a depth of 20 and 30/~m there are two layers consisting of alumina.

phases_and_microstructures.name: Cr-Ni-Al oxide
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

attributes.composition: mainly oxides of chrome, nickel, and aluminum

evidence.quote: The external layer (0-25/~m) consists mainly of oxides of chrome, nickel, and aluminum.

phases_and_microstructures.name: chromium sulfide
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: In deeper layers (35-85/~m) large precipitates of the chrome sulfides alternate with oxides of nickel and cobalt (probably complex spinels).

phases_and_microstructures.name: heterophase oxide film
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

attributes.morphology: highly nonuniform in thickness and composition, slightly bonded particles

evidence.quote: the oxide film is highly nonuniform both in the thickness and composition. Oxide particles have a simple geometrical form and are only slightly bonded together

phases_and_microstructures.name: multilayer scale
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 1 h

evidence.quote: the development of corrosion in the initial stage of testing (holding to 1 h) accompanied by the formation of a multilayer scale

phases_and_microstructures.name: porous loose scale
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: removal by the flow in the composition of a porous, loose scale based on nickel and titanium

phases_and_microstructures.name: pore
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: Consequently, pores form on the metal--oxide surface.

phases_and_microstructures.name: pit
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: The effect of the high-speed gas flow removes scale and leads to the formation of scars (pits).

phases_and_microstructures.name: microcrack
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: Local stress risers (microcracks) form at the bottom of the lattice.

phases_and_microstructures.name: intergranular corrosion
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 1 h

evidence.quote: preferential development of corrosion along the grain boundaries (Fig. 4a)

phases_and_microstructures.name: frontal corrosion
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 8 h

attributes.location: through body of grain; shadow side of specimen

evidence.quote: propagation through the body of the grain (Fig. 4b)

phases_and_microstructures.name: pit-type corrosion
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: On the side of the direct effect of the flow, the scale is considerably thinner and corrosion is of the pit type.
At room temperature the alloy has the following characteristics: %.2 = 680-720 MPa

mechanisms.name: oxide film degradation by erosive gas flow
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: The effect of the high-speed gas flow removes scale and leads to the formation of scars (pits).

mechanisms.name: sulfur-enhanced cation diffusion
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: Sulfur ions can be absorbed by Cr20 3 oxide and increase the diffusion rate of cations.

mechanisms.name: grain-boundary softening
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: This leads to softening of the grain boundaries and creates suitable condition for the formation of macrodamage in the area of separation of individual surface grains.

mechanisms.name: dissolution of gamma-prime phase
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: It is evident that this is caused by dissolution of the y'-phase, by the absence of hardening elements of the solid solution such as molybdenum, tungsten, and chrome, as well as by the formation of porous corrosion products.

mechanisms.name: chromium depletion
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: Depletion of the surface layers in chrome, i.e., the main element providing protection against sulfide corrosion, prevents the formation of a continuous layer of chrome spinel.

mechanisms.name: MoO3 volatilization porosity
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: This is expressed in the development of porosity as a result of generation of MoO 3 volatile compound

mechanisms.name: stress raiser embrittlement by brittle oxide film
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 3 h (polished surface)

evidence.quote: The cracks which act as stress raisers embrittle the material.

mechanisms.name: effective cross-section reduction by scale removal
mechanisms.material_state: exposed to combustion gas flow 25 h

evidence.quote: reduction of the effective cross section as a result of separation and removal of the scale by the flow.
